domains.title: Deferred closer source custody
optionalFields: hold.json lastRetentionAttemptAt: persisted watcher backoff timestamp for bounded retry in the verified worker checkout
hold.json publishedHead: continued exact source can satisfy teardown without a bundle
domains.semantics: Unsafe or unreadable exact-target custody holds successors. Clean matching-target source with confirmed cleanup resumes paced retry. Explicit launches[].custodyRequired retains unsafe fallback; legacy retry entries alone and corrupt retry files do not hold unrelated heads. Teardown retries source bundling and continuation uses bounded lock contention recovery.
